searchText: <@425572898787426305> Should the EL sanity check that the index of the withdrawals are monotonically increasing or is that something that the CL will verify? I updated the test vectors for withdrawals on the cl, had a big issue with them and they were completely wrong, thanks <@792822129019584562> for noticing: https://hackmd.io/PqZgMpnkSWCWv5joJoFymQ Withdrawal indexes are verified by CL, there is no need for EL to do this work lodestar can successfully interop with geth over the new apis (only caveat is geth using "recipient" than "address" for the execution address specification) which i guess will be resolved in the next build
